title: Certify precision-40 κ above PR #3133
body:
## Summary

This precision-only follow-up refines the certified endpoint for PR #3133's unchanged rank-7 coupled words, literal T74 allocation and paid profile. It certifies

- `C40 = 0.0017297760894051203342384678198935738683`
- `κ = C40 - 10^-86 - 10^-62`

The finite candidate exceeds PR #3133's public claim by about `4.6782e-25`. The construction and selected frontier do not change; selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`.

## Scope and limits

This is a conditional finite candidate, not an all-size theorem or selected-frontier update. Both rational moment engines certify the endpoint and the exact comparator proves the increase over PR #3133. The complete source-export, native, replica-admission and outer-release replay passed, with receipts binding the exact words, allocation, claim and manifest. Adjacent-grid and negative controls reject; the precision-30 candidate was not released. No independent human review or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

Remaining work is to test the next endpoint grid against the independent interval enclosure, close the inherited `1.4053e-9` integer-rounding gap with a literal T740 allocation, and test whether a chronological `B_WARP` change can unlock helpers 584 and 590 without returning the savings in restoration.

## Test plan

Registered environment: CPython 3.12.15, `gmpy2` 2.3.2, `mpmath` 1.3.0, NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.15.3 and SymPy 1.14.0. Replayed from a full clone containing the pinned source Git objects:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold-precision40
python3.12 -B research/rank7-coupled-586-588-carrier-fold-precision40/reproduce.py \
  --repo /path/to/full-repository-with-source-objects \
  --work /tmp/rank7-precision40-replay --jobs 2
```

The work reused only the authenticated, hash-checked retained bootstrap/cache.

## Sources and credit

Task `complex-new-helper-inventory`, priority revision 6; scope is limited to refining the certified endpoint of the existing T74 candidate. Package base commit: `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`. Exact construction dependency: [PR #3133](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3133) at `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`; source bindings and receipts are in `SOURCES.json` and `evidence/`. [PR #3136](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3136) independently audited the parent words but does not contain this endpoint refinement. The full predecessor lineage remains in `CREDITS.md`; no construction from concurrent packages is imported. Precision-40 refinement by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
